questions.prompt: Which approach best applies macrobenchmark startup measurement?
options: Control process, compilation, device and fixture state and compare distributions with retained traces.
questions.answer: Control process, compilation, device and fixture state and compare distributions with retained traces.
questions.explanation: This answer preserves the underlying platform or delivery contract while requiring representative evidence, explicit failure behaviour, and operational ownership.

questions.prompt: Macrobenchmark measures code inside the benchmark test process.
questions.explanation: Comparing CompilationMode.None before a change with Partial after it attributes ART compilation benefits to application code.

questions.prompt: Why is compilation mode part of the benchmark result?
questions.answer: ART compilation materially changes execution cost, so results with different modes are not directly comparable.
